result.stdout:
Description:
  Manage LunaPack packs.

Usage:
  luna [command] [options]

Options:
  -w, --workspace <workspace>                          Directory to use as the workspace.
  -ll, --log-level <debug|error|info|verbose|warning>  Minimum log level: verbose, debug, info, warning, or error.
  -?, -h, --help                                       Show help and usage information
  --version                                            Show version information

Commands:
  init                        Create a LunaPack project manifest.
  sources                     Manage pack sources.
  trust                       Manage lifecycle script trust.
  variables                   Manage project variables.
  remap                       Manage managed-file target remappings.
  discover                    List available packs.
  search <term>               Search available packs.
  validate <pack-reference>   Validate a pack in configured sources.
  inspect <pack-reference>    Show a pack manifest.
  install <pack-reference>    Install a pack.
  uninstall <pack-reference>  Remove an installed pack.
  mv <source> <target>        Relocate a managed file while retaining ownership.
  update <pack-reference>     Update installed packs.
  outdated                    List installed packs with newer available releases.
  audit                       Report resolved pack state.

Description:
  Install a pack.

Usage:
  luna install <pack-reference>... [options]

Arguments:
  <pack-reference>  Pack IDs, optionally followed by @version.

Options:
  -d, --destination <destination>                      Directory where the requested pack's files are installed.
  --remap-directory <remap-directory>                  Remap a declared target directory with <source>=<target>.
  --remap-file <remap-file>                            Remap a declared target file with <source>=<target>.
  -a, --adopt-existing                                 Adopt matching existing files for the requested pack.
  -D, --dry-run                                        Plan the installation without modifying files or state.
  -p, --parameter <parameter>                          Template parameter in <name>=<value> form.
  -nv, --no-variables                                  Do not bind matching project variables.
  -sv, --skip-variable <skip-variable>                 Project variable name to skip during parameter binding.
  --scripts <scripts>                                  Lifecycle script mode: prompt, run, or skip.
  -?, -h, --help                                       Show help and usage information
  -w, --workspace <workspace>                          Directory to use as the workspace.
  -ll, --log-level <debug|error|info|verbose|warning>  Minimum log level: verbose, debug, info, warning, or error.
